structures.label: Gluteus maximus
structures.description: Largest muscle of the body, forming the buttock.
structures.function: Extends and externally rotates the hip; key in squats, sprinting and climbing.

structures.label: Gluteus medius
structures.description: Fan-shaped muscle on the side of the pelvis.
structures.function: Abducts the hip and keeps the pelvis level when standing on one leg.

structures.label: Tensor fasciae latae
structures.description: Small muscle at the front of the hip feeding into the iliotibial band.
structures.function: Flexes, abducts and internally rotates the hip.

structures.label: Iliotibial band
structures.description: Thick strip of fascia down the outer thigh to the tibia.
structures.function: Stabilises the outside of the hip and knee.

structures.label: Sartorius
structures.description: Long strap muscle crossing the thigh diagonally.
structures.function: Flexes, abducts and externally rotates the hip (cross-legged position).

structures.label: Rectus femoris
structures.description: Quadriceps muscle that starts on the pelvis.
structures.function: Flexes the hip and straightens the knee.

structures.label: Adductor longus
structures.description: Inner-thigh muscle from the pubis to the femur.
structures.function: Pulls the leg towards the midline; common site of groin strains.

structures.label: Gluteus minimus
structures.description: Smallest gluteal muscle, beneath the medius.
structures.function: Abducts and internally rotates the hip; stabilises the pelvis.

structures.label: Piriformis
structures.description: Pear-shaped muscle from the sacrum to the greater trochanter; the sciatic nerve runs beneath it.

structures.label: Obturator internus & gemelli
structures.description: Small deep muscles behind the hip joint.
structures.function: Externally rotate the hip and hold the femoral head in the socket.

structures.label: Iliopsoas
structures.description: Psoas and iliacus muscles joining to insert on the lesser trochanter.

structures.label: Iliofemoral ligament
structures.description: Y-shaped ligament at the front of the hip, the strongest in the body.
structures.function: Prevents the hip extending too far backwards.

structures.label: Pubofemoral ligament
structures.description: Ligament at the lower front of the hip.

structures.label: Ischiofemoral ligament
structures.description: Spiral ligament at the back of the hip.

structures.label: Acetabular labrum
structures.description: Ring of fibrocartilage around the hip socket.
structures.function: Deepens the socket and seals the joint fluid; can tear in impingement.

structures.label: Hip bone (pelvis)
structures.description: Pelvic bone made of ilium, ischium and pubis, containing the acetabulum.
structures.function: Socket of the hip and attachment for the gluteal and thigh muscles.

structures.label: Femur (proximal)
structures.description: Thigh bone; its ball-shaped head fits into the acetabulum.
structures.function: Transfers body weight to the leg; the neck is where hip fractures occur.

structures.label: Sacrum
structures.description: Triangular bone at the base of the spine.
structures.function: Links the spine to the pelvis through the sacroiliac joints.
